errors.text_span: the purple bar for V4 represents the shortest bar with a value of 68.15
errors.evidence: The description identifies the bar for V4 as the shortest. While its value (68.15) is the lowest, the bar for V2 (value 68.5) is visually depicted as being shorter than the bar for V4 in the chart. The text accurately reports the numerical values but incorrectly maps the 'shortest bar' visual attribute to V4 instead of V2.
